findings.title: Required compact audit rejects duplicate collection bulk
findings.description: Actual exact-reviewed-head compact audit exits 1: the final and retained C9 collection captures store the same 3,345,163 raw bytes in separate 400,494-byte gzip payloads. Both decode to SHA256 f5071343d0ab13e4909a39077eea753bd01ab7956cde2f18b72dbaf436a2cb0d. The unchanged duplicate-bulk rule rejects the final envelope. Eleven execution commands pass, but that does not satisfy the separate required pre-review storage audit.
findings.required_correction: Produce a reviewable correction with zero-error exact-head compact audit, preserving earlier actual statuses, raw bytes, bound records and ancestry; retain the duplicate-bulk rule and all numerical budgets. New implementation/result changes require fresh SHA-bound reviews.
